Former taxidermist here. Freeze drying is actually really great for people with pets. Lots of taxidermists won't touch pets because when you live with Fluffy for 15 years, it's never going to look quite right after a taxidermist finishes. When you see Bambi's Dad for 10 minutes in the woods, it's far different.

Freeze drying works better with pets because no one is fucking with the skin, moving it around, etc. It's just your pet positioned how you like it (some places will actually have you help position them) and when they're done, generally they look great.

It's also a technique used by some taxidermists one really small stuff like mice. It's far easier to just freeze dry them than to try and do the entire taxidermy process on something that small.
